purpose: Teach: 引き取り/製法/未納/受け皿/賭ける/画策/押し付ける/強いる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、お得意様の案件、絶対、引き取り、絶対、誠実に対応したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In those early days, my father took on our VIP clients' work himself with absolute sincerity. I'm asking you — remember that commitment.
lines.style: Measured, gravitas-weighted opening. Slow cadence with pauses between clauses. Voice carries the weight of lived history. Ends on a quiet but firm plea — not commanding, but witnessing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、独自の、絶対、製法、絶対、守ってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Ever since my father's time, we've guarded that unique craft method with complete dedication. I'm grateful for that legacy.
lines.style: Formal, respectful deference. Each phrase lands with precision and care. Composed but warm — acknowledging the inheritance without taking it for granted. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、未納、絶対、お客様にも、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、接したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father treated every customer with patience and respect — even those who were struggling to pay. That was his character.
lines.style: Softer turn inward. Nostalgic but not sentimental. Voice slows slightly as if seeing the memory clearly. Tender recollection, not wistfulness — a statement of fact held with affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、お客様意見の、絶対、受け皿、絶対、整えてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. From my father's era to now, we've built proper channels to listen to what our customers need. That's what we've maintained.
lines.style: Quiet emphasis on 'listen' — a deliberate commitment made visible in the voice. Composed, professional tone but with genuine warmth underneath. Slightly formal phrasing that honors both past and present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、勝負所に、絶対、賭ける、絶対、勇気、絶対、持っていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father had the courage to take real risks when it mattered — to bet on himself when the moment called for it. That took strength.
lines.style: Voice brightens slightly with quiet pride. Deliberate pacing on 'courage' and 'strength' — giving weight to the words. Not boastful, but clear-eyed about the difficulty of what he did. A teaching moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、悪い、絶対、画策、絶対、せず、絶対、誠実な、絶対、商売、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've continued an honest business — never cutting corners, never scheming. That integrity is what we've kept alive.
lines.style: Quiet firmness on 'never.' Speaks with the satisfaction of someone upholding something precious. Measured, respectful, but with conviction underneath — this is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、責任を、絶対、他人に、絶対、押し付ける、絶対、ことなく、絶対、自分で、絶対、引き受けたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father never passed his burden onto others. He carried his own responsibility. He held himself accountable.
lines.style: Direct and unadorned — almost spare in its simplicity. Voice carries quiet authority. Each sentence a small weight, set down carefully. This is about character, and it's stated as fact, not sentiment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員に無理を、絶対、強いる、絶対、ことなく、絶対、家族的な経営、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've treated our employees like family — never demanding more than they can give. That's the spirit we've held.
lines.style: Closes with quiet resolution. Warm but not effusive. Voice steadies into acceptance of stewardship. Final phrase carries the sense of a torch passed and still burning — held with care and humility.
